title: Universal dependency/invalidation service
root_cause: Dependency and stale-state propagation is fragmented across project impact and generated graphs.
source_requirement: Provide one revision-bound invalidation service covering source, skills, agents, workflows, knowledge, formulas, models, projections, tests, sections, and release evidence.
implementation_steps: Define typed dependency nodes and revision bindings.
Adapt existing project-impact and generated graph data.
Compute deterministic direct and transitive invalidation cones.
Expose stale reasons and required rebuild gates.
affected_tests: Project-impact, generated graph, release-evidence, and projection tests.
evidence_required: Deterministic cone vectors and affected-consumer receipt.
rollback: Disable consumers and retain prior project-impact paths until the authority registry is restored.
acceptance_criteria: Every supported dependency class participates in revision-bound transitive invalidation.
Historical artifacts are retained while stale current claims fail closed.
